engine_name: Scene Master Production Assembly & Handoff Director
purpose: Assemble all validated scene intelligence, canonical state, character continuity, perception, frame direction, visual/audio/VFX/environment decisions, asset lineage and provider-neutral production contracts into one immutable scene master package ready for production execution.
core_principle: Production begins only from one validated, lineage-complete, internally consistent scene master.
hard_gates: All required upstream validation gates must be PASS or explicitly approved PASS_WITH_WARNINGS.
Exactly one ACTIVE canonical scene version may be bound.
No unresolved BLOCKER or ERROR may enter the master.
All active characters must remain within the five-character limit.
Every production reference must have lineage and trust status.
Superseded or rejected assets cannot be silently promoted.
Frame specifications must resolve to the same canonical scene version.
Identity, costume, prop and world continuity fingerprints must agree.
Provider-specific syntax must not contaminate the provider-neutral master.
Every output artifact must have an explicit lineage origin.
Master snapshot becomes immutable after handoff; changes require a new revision.

change_policy.minor_change: Non-canonical metadata or execution annotation; requires fingerprint refresh.
change_policy.major_change: Any canonical state, identity, continuity, frame, asset or narrative change; creates a new master revision and invalidates dependent execution jobs.
change_policy.provider_change: Does not alter the master; creates a provider-specific execution derivative.
